# FUZZ-004: Schema-valid tool arguments are not rejected as invalid params

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| warn | both eras, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/server/tools#tool](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/server/tools#tool) |

Judged from the FUZZ-001 traffic. A tool's inputSchema is the JSON Schema defining its expected parameters, so arguments that validate against it should not be answered with -32602 (Invalid params): when they are, the schema promises more than the tool accepts, and a model that follows the schema will fail. Business-logic failures (isError: true) and server errors are not flagged. The failing input is shrunk and saved for mcpprobe replay.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain FUZZ-004`. To leave it out of a run, add `"FUZZ-004"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
